---
title: "Modelling the district"
---

{{< include _includes/preset-help-model.qmd >}}

PEExcel connects the physical simulation of a district with assessment of its energy and climate impacts. Describe buildings, uses and supply, calculate their interactions and compare results. These interactions are particularly useful: a larger PV system, different heat supply or change in use affects several energy flows at once.

## Inputs → simulation → analysis

This overview shows where to start in Excel and where to read about the technical relationships.

| Step | Key question | Excel sheets | Starting point |
|---|---|---|---|
| Buildings and uses | Which areas, envelope properties and use profiles belong to the project? | [🏙]{.excel-menu .darkred} Quartier · [🧱]{.excel-menu .darkred} Bauphysik · [👤]{.excel-menu .darkred} use parameters | [Thermal envelope](envelope.qmd) |
| Components | Which constructions and quantities belong in LCA? | [LCA_Komponenten]{.excel-menu .teal} · [☁ THG]{.excel-menu .teal} | [Component assignment](components.qmd) |
| Supply | How are heat, cooling and electricity supplied? | [🔥H]{.excel-menu .darkred} · [❄K]{.excel-menu .darkred} · [💧WW]{.excel-menu .darkred} · [💨L]{.excel-menu .darkred} · [🌞 PV]{.excel-menu .darkred} | [Building services](hvac.qmd) · [Energy flows](systems.qmd) |
| Location and mobility | Which journeys are generated, and which charging takes place on site? | [🏙]{.excel-menu .darkred} Quartier · [🚗]{.excel-menu .orange} mobility | [Mobility](mobility.qmd) |
| Assessment | Which boundaries and budgets apply? | [PEQ]{.excel-menu .darkred} · [PEQ+M]{.excel-menu .orange} · [KN PEQ]{.excel-menu .teal} | [Declaration](declaration.qmd) |

## What the simulation brings together

### Operational energy model {#simulationsmodell}

The model connects sources, conversion, storage and uses within the district boundary. It covers space heating and cooling, domestic hot water, ventilation, auxiliary energy and user electricity. Local PV generation, storage and flexibility measures change when electricity is imported, used or exported.[^modell]

![District energy model: sources, supply systems, storage and uses connected by energy flows.](../media/manual/energy-model.png){.manual-figure fig-alt="Energy model with grid import, PV, batteries, heat supply, building mass, hot-water storage and uses."}

The diagram helps trace a measure's implications. A heat pump changes both heat supply and electricity demand. Its timing in turn affects [PV generation](pv.qmd) and [storage and flexibility](systems.qmd). [Electric mobility](mobility.qmd) also adds charging demand and available storage capacity.

### Life-cycle assessment

LCA extends the view from ongoing operation to emissions from construction and refurbishment, and the biogenic storage considered. Operational energy and construction measures can thus be assessed together over the study period.

![Life-cycle assessment: operational energy, construction, refurbishment and biogenic storage contribute to emissions over time.](../media/manual/lifecycle.png){.manual-figure fig-alt="Cumulative emissions with operational, construction, refurbishment and biogenic-storage contributions."}

The method determines the contributions and changes over time included. The [LCA page](climate.qmd) explains the study period, decarbonisation and boundaries. For example, assess operational savings together with the construction effort required to achieve them.

## Entering the district {#quartier-eingeben}

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** Open [🏙]{.excel-menu .darkred} **Quartier**. Define project, location and floor areas by use. The subsequent sheets build on these inputs.
:::

| Section | What you define |
|---|---|
| Project description | Project name, variant, description and revision status |
| Location / weather | Municipality and corresponding weather dataset |
| District | Gross floor areas by use |
| Room heights and net floor areas | Clear room heights and net-to-gross floor-area ratio |
| Site area and development density | Developable plot area as the basis for floor-area ratio |
| Refurbishment or new construction | Refurbishment share for each use |

From area and height inputs, the tool derives net floor areas, volumes and floor-area ratio, among other quantities. These provide the basis for further modelling. Then describe the [thermal envelope](envelope.qmd) and [supply systems](hvac.qmd).

Save configurations as [variants](variants.qmd) to investigate different measures. For a later declaration, see [quality assurance](declaration.qmd#qualitaetssicherung) for comparison with project documents.

[^modell]: Figures by the project team; [PEExcel training, slides 7–16 and 30](../downloads/schulung.pdf) (German). See [preparing data](interfaces.qmd) for data transfer.
